assign.request: Build ext/Playground properties.js: static fields tables in items.js, three controls (seg/text/num), the change path in Playground.js (no repaint, live node write, readout, save), playground.css pg- rules. Prove headless per the brief.
assign.now: reading design.md and the MVP code
steps: add static fields to items.js (Flex + Box)
wire the change path into Playground.js (no repaint)
headless proof: DOM identity + readout + saved json diff + reload

assign.outcome:
**Properties column + change path landed** — `properties.js` draws `seg`/`text`/`num` controls from each Item's `static fields` (already correct on `Flex`/`Box` in `items.js` from task 1: box/child/flex keys per design §3); each control calls `item.set(key, value)`, which emits `change` and bubbles to the root. `Playground.js`'s new `change` listener writes `item.styles()` onto the live canvas node (no repaint), refreshes the readout text, saves — `.pg-properties-body`'s DOM identity holds across the write.

**Proved headless, 1280:** selecting the seeded Flex and clicking `justify` → `space-between`: computed `justify-content` `normal → space-between`; `document.querySelector(".pg-properties-body") === propsBody` held **true** across the change; readout text `===` the node's `getAttribute("style")` both before and after (`display: flex; flex-direction: row; justify-content: space-between; gap: 1em; padding: 2em`); the saved `/data/playground/untitled.json` diffs to exactly one added line, `"justify": "space-between"`, nothing else touched; a fresh reload shows the `SPACE-BETWEEN` button active and the readout already populated. Zero console errors at `/framework/ext/Playground/` across three separate headless runs.

**One bug fixed while proving:** a seg button's own highlight only updated on a full `paint_properties()` rebuild, which a `change` deliberately never runs — so the control looked dead after a click even though the canvas and readout were right. Fixed by toggling `.pg-seg-active` on the matching field's existing buttons inside `apply_change()` (classList only, no node created/destroyed — still “no repaint”).
